tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs byed tshul bzhugs so// na ma badz+ra wā ra h+yai/ rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje btsun mo la btud nas/ /de yi byin rlabs cho ga ni/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis yod pa las/ chung ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams las rgyud pa'i/ mchog sgrub pa'i dmar mo skor gsum zhes grags pa'i nang tshan zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga byed na/ tshes bcu gnyis po gang rung la 'og tu rdul tshon dmar po'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi mthar 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa bri/ lha so so'i mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon spungs bkod pa'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dar dmar gyi kha bcad pa'i steng du/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la dbus su baṃ la oṃ gsum mas g.yon skor du bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi gra rnams su go cha'i sngags g.yon bskor/ gra bzhir dga' 'khyil/ 'khor lo la thig le bkod/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa g.yon skor gtor ma gsum bshams/ gzhan yang rdor dril nang mchod bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dus byas la/ bdag bskyed paṇ+ṭi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin byas nas/ bum pa'i nang du rnal 'byor ma/ lha lnga bskyed/ go cha bcings ye shes pa bcu drug dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod bstod/ oṃ gsum ma sum+bha ni a bhi ṣe ka ta rnams bzlas/ yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs lha rnams gtso mo baṃ dang / go cha rnams so so'i sngags dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad hūm̐ las bskyed/ rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs kyi bar byas nas brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya/

phyi nang gi mchod bstod/ bdag 'jug ma byas kyang chog gsungs na'ang / slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba'i bdag 'jug blang na legs/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas me tog dgye bsdu sems bskyed gsal gdab/ maṇ+ḍal/ gang drin ma sho lo ka gcig dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /tshig rkang gnyis dang / dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /byin rlabs bdag la bstsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs dang / sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun la sogs sdom pa gzung / mig dar me tog bum chus bsangs/ bdud rtsi blud 'dod pa dri/ nang gi sems bskyed gsang bar gdams/ slob ma rnams lū nag ltar mthe bong sbrel du bcug la/ rtog pas dkrugs pa'i sems kyis ni sogs kyi don bshad la gus 'dud byed du bcug nas/ khyed rang rnams rkang mthil du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos pas sum mdo'i me sbar te lus tha mal pa bsregs/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pas stong pa'i ngang las phag mor bskyed/ lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs baṃ yig sngags phreng dga' 'khyil sogs gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ slob ma'i lte ba'i 'khor lo la phog pas lte ba'i baṃ las me glog gi zer ma lta bu 'phros pas g.yas ro ma nas song rna ba g.yas pa nas 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad byang sems dkar po'i rnam par byung ba spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbu ma nas babs/ lte bar 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad/ yang lte ba'i 'od g.yas ro ma nas song / phag zhal gyi g.yung drung ris la phog myur du 'khor bas bde stong gi ye shes skyes par mos/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad phag mo'i rnam pas thim par mos mdzod byas la/ ḍa ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra bya/ gu gul gyi bdug oṃ gsum ma bzla/ tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par bya/

me tog dor/ gdong dbye/ dkyil 'khor bstan/ dbang gi sngon du maṇ+ḍal/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba gsum dkyil 'khor gyi lhor dbang stegs khri dang pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la slob ma phag mor bskyed/ go cha dgod/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ dbang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis spyan drangs/ gsol ba btab/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs bya/ ji ltar bltams/ ka kā s+ye sogs kyis dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha bstim su pras brtan par bya/ bum dbang ngo / /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zag med kyi bde ba 'od dmar por byung / thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim pa lag pa g.yon par byin/ yi ge gsum dang sngags brjod/ gsal stong la mnyam par 'jog pa gsang dbang ngo / /slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba byang sems dkar po'i rnam pas bha ga nas zhugs/ rim pas gyen du drangs/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes par mos/ sin+dhū ra'i sngags kyi rdul tshon bla ma'i srin lag g.yon pas blangs la lte bar byug dga' 'khyil dpral bar byug go cha'i sngags spyi gtsug tu byug pa sher ye'o/ /de nas bde stong la mnyam par gzhag 'di ni rang nyid sogs kyis ngo sprad de bzhi pa'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs bya/ rjes cho ga mchod pa byin rlabs phyi nang gi mchod bstod/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rang la bstim/ go bgo tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung / dge ba bsngo bkra shis bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dben gnas gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'o// //bistā ro da ya bha wan+tu/ e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ zhal gnyis pa'i byin rlabs byed tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
